stage.name: Assorted Gummies
stage.description:
Condition: 
<Basic Originium Slugs> and <Gourmet Slugs> are invisible.

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.name: Originium Slug β
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.flavourText: An infected wild creature that is more dangerous than an Originium Slug α. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime.name: Originium Slug
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime.flavourText: An infected wild creature. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

gourmet_slug.name: Gourmet Slug
gourmet_slug.flavourText: A free-range Originium slug raised with care, though it still retains a fierce streak. The quality of its meat hasn't improved much either. Requires a complex process to make edible.
abilities: Flees when HP is under 50%! Gains bonus Movement Speed and cannot be blocked for a period of time.

infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.name: Infused Originium Slug α
infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.flavourText: An infected wild creature that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen, exploding upon death. More dangerous than a normal Infused Originium Slug. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
abilities: Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units

acid_originium_slug_enemy_1004_mslime.name: Acid Originium Slug
acid_originium_slug_enemy_1004_mslime.flavourText: An infected wild creature that can secrete corrosive fluids strong enough to dissolve armor. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
abilities: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

pyric_originium_slug.name: Pyric Originium Slug
pyric_originium_slug.flavourText: A wild infected creature, the final stages of infection having led them to burn even hotter. Their fluids, hot as magma, melt even their own bodies. Once cooled, beautiful patterns can be found in the pools they leave behind.

infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.name: Infused Glacial Originium Slug α
infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.flavourText: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. More threatening than normal Infused Glacial Originium Slugs, they explode upon death, damaging and freezing nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.
abilities: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies Cold to affected targets

fruit_slug.name: Fruit Slug
fruit_slug.flavourText: A creepy-crawly that lives in a mild environment. When the ripe fruits dangle from the symbiotic plant atop its back, that's the best time to harvest them.
abilities: Releases a blinding gleam upon taking damage, stunning surrounding allies for an extended period before attempting to escape via digging.
Drops <Shiny Berry> if defeated before escaping.

blackwater_originium_slug_enemy_1246_asl.name: Blackwater Originium Slug α
blackwater_originium_slug_enemy_1246_asl.flavourText: A wild infected creature that is more dangerous than a normal Blackwater Originium Slug. It normally lives in the nomadic city's sewers, but has surfaced after being provoked. Both its striking odor and its elusiveness often catch people off-guard.

basic_slug.name: Basic Slug
basic_slug.flavourText: An Originium slug raised in captivity. Has a relatively low infection rate and a rather ordinary taste. Its anatomical structure is different from that of wild slugs.
abilities: Flees when HP is under 50%! Gains bonus Movement Speed and cannot be blocked for a period of time.
